description: Applies a named Lumetri color preset to a video clip and verifies it took effect. Because the engine reports success even when nothing changes, this confirms the clip either gained a Lumetri Color component or that an existing one's values changed, and reports failure honestly otherwise. Targets a specific clip when given one, else the current video-clip selection. Makes the target sequence active.

clip_name.description: Target a single video clip by node id or name; the tool selects only it. Alternates: clipNodeId, nodeId, clipId. If omitted, the current video-clip selection is used.

preset_name.description: (required) Exact preset name from list_lumetri_presets (matched case/format-insensitively). Alternates: presetName, preset.

sequenceId.description: Target sequence id; active sequence if omitted.

name: apply_lumetri_preset
